name: Price (Search API)
project_description: Arch Price Search API is a submodule of the Arch commerce suite that adds a price Views filter to Search API indexes. When an index named 'products' exposes Arch price fields (matching arch_price_net/gross_* real fields), it registers an 'arch_price_value_filter' Views filter backed by the SearchApiPriceFilter plugin. The filter lets a view constrain products by net or gross price in a chosen (optionally exposed) currency, and only considers price types the current user is allowed to view, so price-type access control carries over into faceted search.
